% Known-bad for check_template_use: the template IS \input, but shipped
% identifiers are shadowed afterwards. Pins the broadened verb list — the
% definitions use \newenvironment and \renewcommand (which the original
% \newmdenv/\newcommand-only scan missed; the repo's own trio fixture once
% stubbed examplebox exactly this way) plus \definecolor. Must FAIL rule C.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage[margin=0.85in, top=0.7in, bottom=0.7in]{geometry}
\input{worksheet-preamble}
\newenvironment{examplebox}{}{}
\renewcommand{\ans}[1]{\boxed{#1}}
\definecolor{skillblue}{RGB}{0,0,0}
\begin{document}
\skillheading{Evaluating functions}
\begin{examplebox}
For $f(x) = 2x + 1$: $f(2) = \ans{5}$
\end{examplebox}
\end{document}
